title: Delhi HC Fines Delhi Govt Rs 1 Lakh For Ignoring Industrial Plot Order
seo_title: Delhi HC Fines Govt Over Plot Allotment Delay
case_name: Central Footwear Co. v. Government of NCT of Delhi & Anr.
card_summary: The Delhi High Court imposed Rs 1 lakh costs on the Delhi government for repeatedly ignoring its own earlier directions in a company's long-pending claim for an alternative industrial plot. Justice Amit Mahajan ordered the amount recovered from the responsible officers' salaries, payable to the Delhi High Court Legal Services Committee. The petitioner had moved the court four times over the plot claim.
card_tip: Where a government department keeps ignoring a favourable order, a petition seeking costs against the department with personal recovery from the responsible officers can help force compliance.
verification_notes: AUDIENCE: domestic (industrial plot allottees and businesses dealing with Delhi government bodies). TARGET QUERY: can a court recover costs personally from government officers for ignoring its orders. DEMAND EVIDENCE: none seen. Confirmed from LiveLaw and Verdictum reports of the 6 Nov 2026 order in W.P.(C) 16614/2024 (Justice Amit Mahajan); facts on the plot and relocation scheme cross-checked against CourtBook's summary of the order.
